maudhui: (1) Subject to the other provisions of this Constitution, the life of every Parliament shall be a period of five years. (2) For the purposes of this Constitution, the expression "life of Parliament" means the whole period commencing on the date on which a new Parliament is summoned to meet for the first time after a General Election and ending on the date of dissolution of Parliament for the purpose of enabling another ordinary General Election to be held.
